original_prompt:
# 09 · 眼周优化

2026-11-22 · 内置 image_gen · 双侧黑眼圈与眼袋淡化，保留自然肤质与正面构图。

Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the edit target. Make a localized, natural photographic retouch of BOTH under-eye areas of this exact young girl. Remove or greatly reduce the purple/brown dark circles, puffy eye bags and pronounced tear-trough shadows under both eyes. Blend the under-eye skin tone naturally into the upper cheeks, with soft subtle volume and a tiny natural lower eyelid fold, so she looks fresher, well-rested, softer and more youthful. Preserve her identity and existing childlike facial proportions, eye size and shape, direct gaze, freckles and realistic skin texture. No adult makeup, heavy concealer, artificial porcelain skin or exaggerated doll eyes. Keep the rest of the portrait as unchanged as possible: exact hairstyle, twin buns, blue flower clips, hairpins, earrings, white crewneck shirt, facial expression, nose, lips, eyebrows, face outline, centered chest-up framing and scale. Maintain strict straight-front eye-level pose, horizontal pupils and centered nose-mouth-chin, bright even soft neutral lighting and pure white background. Same 1086x1448 vertical 3:4 framing. Output one photorealistic portrait only, no text or watermark.
